sourceContract: Cursor agent hook `afterMCPExecution`: `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `result_json`, `duration` (ms) — and no status field
author: otel-hook cursor provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Real key set, synthetic values. The MCP server, tool, query, and result are invented; no real MCP server is referenced.
licenseBasis: Original authorship; only the field names and their types are taken from the published reference.
providerVersionObserved: not observed in the cited captures; shape from cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks alone
notes: No capture in colinsurprenant/director hack/canary/cursor-cli/findings exercised MCP, so this fixture rests on the published reference only — which is why the adapter reports its tool end with outcome `unknown` rather than reading a status out of result_json. It carries the same 84.5 duration as post-tool-use-mcp.json so the two can be compared: the pinned Python reference scales this event's `duration` by 1000 and leaves the postToolUse one alone (DIVERGENCE-008).
